green-revolution.def: The spread of high-yield seeds, chemical fertilizer, irrigation, pesticides and machines to farms in many less developed countries, from about the 1960s to the 1980s; sometimes called the Third Agricultural Revolution.

high-yield-seed.def: A crop variety bred, by crossing plants, to produce much more grain per hectare when given water and fertilizer, such as the wheat bred in Mexico and the rice IR8.

gmo.def: A genetically modified organism: a plant or animal whose genes were changed in a lab, for example by adding a gene from another species. GMO crops were first sold in the late 1990s.
